# GraphTopologyAwareSpiking

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking computation paradigm where the graph structure of variables directly shapes synaptic connectivity and spike propagation paths. Aligns network topology with data dependencies, reducing communication overhead and improving scalability in distributed neuromorphic systems.
